ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels, with a high-intensity (white) pixel ratio of approximately 5-8% localized primarily at the distal tips and proximal notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curves extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, upward-pointing vertices.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible high-contrast white scarring/pigmentation concentrated at the extreme lateral edges of the fluke and sparse spotting near the peduncle attachment point.
